_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shops" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "address1" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "address2" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "footer" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "shop_secret" TEXT NOT NULL, "expiry_warn_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, "max_worker_discount_pct" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NOT NULL, "sell_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "buy_price" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "low_stock_threshold" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "deliveries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "buy_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expiry_date" TEXT NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NULL, "received_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "subtotal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_now" INTEGER NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sell_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_allocations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "delivery_id" TEXT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "losses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "unit_cost" INTEGER NOT NULL, "delivery_id" TEXT NULL, "return_item_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "returns" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "refund_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "return_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "return_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "back_to_stock" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("back_to_stock" IN (0, 1)), "refund" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suppliers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "note" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplier_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "validated_by" TEXT NULL, "validated_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "note" TEXT NULL, "credit_limit" INTEGER NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "pin_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "pin_salt" TEXT NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "pin_length" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4, "locked_out" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("locked_out" IN (0, 1)), "recovery_hash" TEXT NULL, "recovery_salt" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "change_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "field" TEXT NOT NULL, "old_value" TEXT NULL, "new_value" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "failed_logins" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "seen" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("seen" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX products_barcode ON products (barcode)
CREATE INDEX deliveries_product ON deliveries (product_id)
CREATE INDEX deliveries_supplier ON deliveries (supplier_id)
CREATE INDEX sales_created ON sales (created_at)
CREATE INDEX sales_customer ON sales (customer_id)
CREATE INDEX sale_items_sale ON sale_items (sale_id)
CREATE INDEX sale_items_product ON sale_items (product_id)
CREATE INDEX stock_allocations_product ON stock_allocations (product_id)
CREATE INDEX stock_allocations_source ON stock_allocations (source_id)
CREATE INDEX losses_product ON losses (product_id)
CREATE INDEX returns_sale ON returns (sale_id)
CREATE INDEX return_items_sale_item ON return_items (sale_item_id)
CREATE INDEX supplier_payments_supplier ON supplier_payments (supplier_id)
CREATE INDEX supplier_payments_status ON supplier_payments (status)
CREATE INDEX customer_payments_customer ON customer_payments (customer_id)
CREATE INDEX change_logs_entity ON change_logs (entity_id)
CREATE INDEX failed_logins_seen ON failed_logins (seen)
